description: This file contains functions related to JWT token verification, signature validation, public key management, and token data validation, used for authentication purposes within the web UI project.

methods.name: VerifyToken
methods.description: Verifies a JWT token by checking its structure, signature, and validity period.

methods.name: VerifySignature
methods.description: Validates the cryptographic signature of the JWT using the public key fetched from the key server.

methods.name: VerifyTokenData
methods.description: Checks the token payload for time validity and matching tenant ID.

methods.name: WritePubKey
methods.description: Writes a given public key to the designated PUBKEYFILE.

methods.name: LogTokenData
methods.description: Logs token-related information and errors to a log file.

methods.name: base64decode_url
methods.description: Decodes base64 URL-encoded strings with proper padding and character replacements.

methods.name: CheckModTimeValid
methods.description: Checks if the key file modification time is within the valid window.
